scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.setup:backend: py -3.12 -m venv backend\.venv && backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip && backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r backend\requirements.txt
